report:
I graded all 57 windows and every one is in the shard (`annotations/labels/judgment/l2-last_safe_evidence-v9-p2.jsonl`). Two Thompson windows were rejected the first time because their refs fell outside the window; I fixed the refs and resubmitted. I then regraded three Rec_Tent_129 windows, which replaced the earlier grades rather than adding duplicates.

**Grade counts:** 25 × grade 2, 9 × grade 1, 23 × grade 0, no −1.

**Episodes found** (onset is when the robot starts accelerating; speeds are from odometry, lidar and cameras from `sync` just before each onset):

| Recording | Episode | Onset | Grade 2 | Grade 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GDC_Library_42 | Start from rest at recording start | 1.95 s | 0004–0006 | – |
| GDC_Library_42 | Stops at a glass door (stationary 14.9–16.6 s, then creeps ≤0.25 m/s) and accelerates through it | 18.3 s | 0018–0023 | 0015–0017 (slowing, then stopped), 0024 (ramp) |
| Rec_Tent_129 | Start from rest at recording start | ~1.8 s | – | 0004–0006 (no main front-camera frame before the onset) |
| Rec_Tent_129 | Stop 6.3–7.8 s | 7.8 s | 0010 | – |
| Rec_Tent_129 | Brief halt in a crowd, ≤0.05 m/s for 61.8–62.2 s | 62.25 s | 0066 | – |
| Rec_Tent_129 | Stop 139.5–141.1 s | 141.2 s | 0141–0145 | 0140 (slowing, then stopped) |
| Rec_Tent_129 | Pause in a crowd: 0.03–0.05 m/s for only ~0.35 s | 179.65 s | – | 0183 (whether this counts as a stop is marginal) |
| Sanjac | Start from rest | 0.95 s | 0005 | – |
| Sanjac_Rec_91 | Start from rest | 1.75 s | 0004–0006 | – |
| Stadium_Sanjac_90 | Start from rest | 0.55 s | 0004 | – |
| Stadium_Sanjac_90 | Stop at a crosswalk, 40.6–41.25 s | 41.25 s | 0043–0045 | – |
| Stadium_Sanjac_90 | Stop 48.1–48.85 s | 48.85 s | 0050 | – |

**Grade 0:** slowdowns where the robot never came to rest, or cruising.
- The closest near-misses: JCL:0063 (down to 0.16 m/s), Rec_Tent_129:0303–0304 (about 0.1 m/s while turning in place, 38° over 2 s), and the Sanjac and Stadium slow stretches at 0.32–0.38 m/s.
- Sanjac:0066 ends before that recording's brief halt at 67.4 s.
- The Library_Fountain_5, Thompson, Library_MLK:0113 and GDC_Library_42:0246–0247 windows are all cruising.

**Parts of the intent the data can't establish (for the `answered_partial` analysis):**
- **Side and rear images on the Jackal recordings** (Sanjac, Sanjac_Rec_91, Stadium_Sanjac_90, Library_Fountain_5): these robots only have a front camera and a 2D scan. I still gave 2, reading "latest available" as whatever sensors exist, which matches the earlier Brackenridge grades. If a strict reading wants side and rear images, those 9 windows should drop to 1.
- **Pose and transform ages:** the `/tf` topic exists (50 Hz on Rec_Tent_129), but `sync` only reports camera and lidar ages. Pose and transform ages have to be inferred from odometry timing.
- **Front camera at recording start:** on Rec_Tent_129 the main front camera doesn't publish before the 1.8 s onset, so there is no "latest front image" for that episode. That's why 0004–0006 are 1, following the p1 labeller's Bass_Garage precedent.
- **Body-camera staleness:** the Spot body-camera frames arrive about 0.4–0.5 s after capture. At each onset they show the scene about 0.5–0.7 s earlier than the front camera and lidar, which are under 100 ms old.
- **Where a "stop" ends:** very brief halts (≤0.5 s) sit on the edge of the definition. I gave 2 when speed stayed essentially at zero (Rec_Tent_129 at 62 s) and 1 when the pause was shorter and never reached zero once averaged (179.5 s).
